---
title: VideHelper
description: Vide reactive UI cleanup utilities for proper resource disposal
---

import { Code } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

## Overview

VideHelper provides cleanup utilities that integrate with the Vide reactive UI framework. It handles proper disposal of functions, instances, connections, and threads within Vide's reactive scopes.

## Usage

### Basic Cleanup

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)
local Vide = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Vide)

-- In a Vide component
local function MyComponent(props)
    local connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        -- some work
    end)
    
    -- Ensure cleanup when component unmounts
    VideHelper.clean(connection)
    
    return Vide.create 'Frame' {
        -- component contents
    }
end
```

### Function Cleanup

```lua
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)

-- Register a cleanup function
VideHelper.clean(function()
    print('Component unmounting, cleaning up...')
    -- Release resources, disconnect things, etc.
end)
```

### Instance Destruction

```lua
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)

-- Track an instance for cleanup
local tempPart = Instance.new('Part')
tempPart.Anchored = true
tempPart.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
tempPart.Parent = workspace

VideHelper.clean(tempPart)
-- Part will be destroyed when scope cleans up
```

### Connection Disposal

```lua
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)

-- RBXScriptConnections need special handling
local signal = Instance.new('BindableEvent')
local connection = signal.Event:Connect(function(value)
    print('Received:', value)
end)

VideHelper.clean(connection)
-- Connection will be disconnected on cleanup
```

### Thread Cancellation

```lua
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)

-- Track a running thread
local thread = task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        print('Working...')
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

VideHelper.clean(thread)
-- Thread will be cancelled if still running when scope ends
```

### Complete Component Example

```lua
local VideHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage.Vendor.VideHelper)
local Vide = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Vide)

local function AutoUpdatingLabel(props)
    local text = Vide.source('Initial')
    
    -- Set up polling that auto-cleans
    local pollThread = task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            text(fetchLatestValue())
            task.wait(5)
        end
    end)
    VideHelper.clean(pollThread)
    
    -- Track connection
    local conn = props.signal.Event:Connect(function(newText)
        text(newText)
    end)
    VideHelper.clean(conn)
    
    -- Return reactive label
    return Vide.create 'TextLabel' {
        Text = text,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50),
    }
end
```

## API Reference

### clean

```lua
function VideHelper.clean(thing: Function | Instance | RBXScriptConnection | thread)
```

Registers an object for cleanup within the current Vide scope.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `thing` | `function` | Cleanup function to call on unmount |
| `thing` | `Instance` | Instance to destroy on unmount |
| `thing` | `RBXScriptConnection` | Connection to disconnect on unmount |
| `thing` | `thread` | Thread to cancel on unmount |

**Behavior by type:**
- **Function**: Called directly via `Vide.cleanup(thing)`
- **Instance**: Destroyed via `Vide.cleanup(thing)`
- **RBXScriptConnection**: Wrapped in cleanup function that calls `:Disconnect()`
- **Thread**: Wrapped in cleanup function that calls `task.cancel(thing)` if not dead

## Integration with Vide

VideHelper is a thin wrapper around Vide's built-in `cleanup` function that handles type-specific disposal logic:

```lua
-- Vide's native cleanup (requires function)
Vide.cleanup(function()
    instance:Destroy()
end)

-- VideHelper handles the wrapping
VideHelper.clean(instance)
```

## Best Practices

- **Call `clean` immediately after creation** — don't delay cleanup registration
- **Use for all external resources** — connections, spawned threads, temporary instances
- **Prefer over manual cleanup** — Vide handles the lifecycle automatically
- **Works inside `Vide.root`** — cleanup triggers when root scope ends
- **Combine with Vide sources** — reactive updates plus automatic cleanup
- **For complex cleanup** — pass a function: `VideHelper.clean(function() ... end)`
